name: alata-studio
description: Octopus Studio - an enterprise AI workbench & agent server (derivative of AnythingLLM, MIT-licensed).
author: Mintplex Labs Inc. (upstream AnythingLLM) & Octopus Studio maintainers

scripts.lint: cd server && yarn lint && cd ../frontend && yarn lint && cd ../collector && yarn lint
scripts.setup: yarn setup:envs && yarn prisma:setup && echo "Run yarn dev:all to start server, frontend, and collector."
scripts.setup:envs:
cp -n ./frontend/.env.example ./frontend/.env && cp -n ./server/.env.example ./server/.env.development && cp -n ./collector/.env.example ./collector/.env && cp -n ./docker/.env.example ./docker/.env && echo "All ENV files copied!
"
scripts.dev:all:full: npx concurrently "yarn dev:server" "yarn dev:frontend" "yarn dev:collector" "yarn dev:paddleocr" "yarn dev:visual"
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.prisma:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.prisma:setup: yarn prisma:generate && yarn prisma:migrate && yarn prisma:seed
scripts.prod:frontend: cd frontend && cross-env VITE_API_BASE=/api yarn build
scripts.normalize:translations: cd frontend/src/locales && node normalizeEn.mjs && cd ../../.. && yarn lint && yarn verify:translations
scripts.electron:build:arm64: yarn prod:frontend && yarn electron:stage:arm64 && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.electron:build:arm64:unsigned: yarn prod:frontend && yarn electron:stage:arm64 && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false NODE_ENV=production electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.electron:build:arm64:signed-local: yarn prod:frontend && yarn electron:stage:arm64 && cross-env ALATA_MAC_CODESIGN_DISABLE_TIMESTAMP=true NODE_ENV=production electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.electron:build:x64: yarn prod:frontend && yarn electron:stage:x64 && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron-builder --mac --x64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.electron:build:x64:unsigned: yarn prod:frontend && yarn electron:stage:x64 && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false NODE_ENV=production electron-builder --mac --x64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs
